mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_profile (id, user_id, name, pet_type, breed, age_months, weight_kg, notes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{petType}, #{breed}, #{ageMonths}, #{weightKg}, #{notes}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pet_profile WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
